description: Wraps lottie-web (SVG renderer) to play a JSON animation file. Used for hero decorative animations and the Consolidate page's scroll-scrubbed hero.

src.description: path to a real .json lottie file under /lottie/

motion.playback: plays the referenced Lottie JSON via SVG renderer; may be scroll-scrubbed (see sections/hero-consolidate.json) or scroll-triggered play/reset (mobile)
motion.reducedMotionFallback: renders first frame statically (goToAndStop(0)), no autoplay, no scroll-scrub
